core-discipline.description: Operational discipline for native IDEs/CLIs: plan in read-only mode, commit atomically and triage reviews before editing.

skills.description: Read-only planning protocol: investigate first, propose atomic phases with affected files and a verification command, and wait for approval before editing.
Split implementation work into atomic, compilable semantic commits and verify each step before committing.
Triage PR review comments against the real code before applying them: classify as valid, optional or false positive and wait for selection.
Consistent HTTP API error envelopes: stable codes, safe messages, status mapping and no sensitive data in logs.
